## time for research

A quarto document with sql, R and python code.

```{R}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
con_fec <- DBI::dbConnect(
  drv = duckdb::duckdb(),
  dbdir = "./database.db"
)
```

```{sql temptable}
--| label: get-carriers
--| connection: con_fec
--| echo: false
--| warning: false
create temp table candidate_committee_research as
        SELECT *
        FROM
                mart.donations AS donations
        INNER JOIN mart.committee AS committee
                ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
        INNER JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
                ON committee.committee_identification = cc_linkage.committee_id
        INNER JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
                ON candidate.candidate_id = cc_linkage.candidate_id
        GROUP BY
                ALL;

```


```{sql init}
--| label: init-analysis 
--| connection: con_fec
--| echo: false
--| warning: false
select 
      candidate_name,
      total_receipts 
from candidate_committee_research
group by all 
order by total_receipts desc
```
